canonical.title: Consent & Data Rights Manager
canonical.job: Let people understand and control consent, access, correction, deletion, retention and downstream use.
canonical.bWeb: A static checkbox becomes a living rights and permission surface.

integrity: Current state reconciled to event history
Evidence-bearing purpose terms and named rights routes
boundaries: Product-control demonstration, not a legal determination of consent validity, applicable rights, lawful basis, identity, authorization, deadlines, exemptions, or deletion duties.
Withdrawal changes future processing relying on that permission; it does not itself erase prior records or override another lawful basis or governing retention requirement.
Synthetic browser-local fixture; do not enter personal data.
